rationale: The unit of interest is the individual person or the distinct engineered genotype, not the paper, because the same patient-derived lines recur across many papers and would otherwise be counted repeatedly. Fields are built around the two axes the review question needs joined - residual BubR1 dosage and phenotype - and every dosage value must carry its own denominator because percentages from a fibroblast blot and a MEF blot are not the same measurement.

record_wrapper.card_type: one of the universal types below

source_context.description: paper-level metadata: design, country, ascertainment route, funding, whether patient-level data are primary or restated from an earlier report

analysis_unit.description: one individual person, or one distinct engineered/model genotype
analysis_unit.relationship: many units per paper; one unit may appear in many papers, linked by duplicate_of

finding.description: one extracted value: a dosage percentage, an aneuploidy percentage, a tumour event, a phenotype feature, or a survival datum

definition.description: the source's own operational definition of MVA, PCS, aneuploidy threshold, or dosage measurement

categories.human_biallelic_BUB1B: Individual with two germline BUB1B variants
categories.human_monoallelic_BUB1B: Individual with one germline BUB1B variant, including incidental findings in tumour cohorts and RPL carriers
categories.human_MVA_other_gene: Individual with MVA/PCS attributed to a non-BUB1B gene
categories.human_MVA_unsolved: Individual with MVA/PCS and no causal gene identified
categories.model_dosage: Mouse or engineered cell system with a defined BubR1 dosage
categories.patient_derived_line: An immortalised or primary line from a patient, used functionally

fields.allele_1_hgvs_c: string; cDNA change verbatim with transcript if given
fields.allele_1_class: enum-ish, open: nonsense | frameshift | splice | missense | insertion | deletion | Alu_insertion | large_deletion | not_reported
fields.allele_1_domain: string; domain per protocol domain map, or 'linker' or 'not_applicable'
fields.residual_protein_pct: number or null; BubR1 protein as % of same-report control
fields.residual_protein_denominator: string verbatim: material + loading control + method
fields.residual_protein_source: text | table | figure_only  <- figure_only is NOT eligible for the verified repo
fields.aneuploidy_pct: number or null, with cell type
fields.pcs_pct: number or null, with cell type
fields.other_phenotype_verbatim: string; preserved as written, not binned
fields.treatment_received_verbatim: string or null; including any toxicity or dose reduction attributed to the diagnosis
fields.ascertainment_route: string; how the individual came to attention - matters for publication bias

definitions.residual dosage: see protocol operational_definitions - same-report ratio only
definitions.threshold: a dosage value below which a named phenotype is observed and above which it is not, within the SAME denominator class. A threshold asserted across denominator classes is not a threshold, it is an artefact.

provisional_normalizations.note: Histology, phenotype and assay names are OPEN vocabularies preserved as_reported. Only variant class, zygosity, and residual_protein_source are bounded.
